title: [Bug]: `step` decorator for workflow steps doesn't support postponed type annotations
body:
### Bug Description

Sometimes while working in Python I use `from __future__ import annotations`.

Turns out, `@step` decorator for workflow steps can't recognize "postponed type annotations". When you use `annotations` from `__future__` types in declarations are changed to **strings**.

### Version

0.12.25

### Steps to Reproduce

Here is an example that doesn't work properly:

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio

from llama_index.core.workflow import StartEvent, StopEvent, Workflow, step


class MyStart(StartEvent):
    pass


class Test(Workflow):
    @step
    def example(self, ev: MyStart) -> StopEvent:
        print(ev)
        return StopEvent()


async def main():
    w = Test()
    await w.run()


asyncio.run(main())
```

### Relevant Logs/Tracbacks

```shell
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "[REDACTED]/test.py", line 9, in <module>
    class Test(Workflow):
    ...<3 lines>...
            return StopEvent()
  File "[REDACTED]/test.py", line 10, in Test
    @step
     ^^^^
  File "[REDACTED]/.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/llama_index/core/workflow/decorators.py", line 86, in step
    decorator(func)
    ~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^
  File "[REDACTED]/.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/llama_index/core/workflow/decorators.py", line 60, in decorator
    validate_step_signature(spec)
    ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^
  File "[REDACTED]/.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/llama_index/core/workflow/utils.py", line 135, in validate_step_signature
    raise WorkflowValidationError(msg)
llama_index.core.workflow.errors.WorkflowValidationError: Step signature must have at least one parameter annotated as type Event
```

linked_prs.title: support postponed type hints in step signatures
linked_prs.body:
# Description

## Summary of the Change

This fix ensures that the `@step` decorator in `llama_index` correctly handles postponed type annotations introduced by `from __future__ import annotations`.

## Issue Fixed

Fixes a bug where workflow step functions could not use `from __future__ import annotations`, causing:
```
WorkflowValidationError: Step signature must have at least one parameter annotated as type Event
```
This happened because `inspect_signature` expected class types but received string representations of them. This is because postponed annotations are stored as strings.

Fixes #18205
